content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated error rate (5xx) + latency spike observed for hosted inference in us-west-2. Auto-threshold violated. PD: P1.

alice_oncall: grabbing this. seeing token-level latency spikes and some OOM kills on worker-3. dashboard shows continuous-batching queue backlog rising.

ben_runtime: saw the same. KV cache memory usage on the shard hosting worker-3 jumped by ~3x in 3m. suspect cache blowup due to reuse policy.

carol_sre: paging infra - are there autoscale events? any scheduled deploys?

devops-ci: no recent deploys in the window. autoscaler did not trigger, but kube eviction events at 1867499945 for worker-3.

alice_oncall: attaching recent logs snippet from worker-3: 
```
2026-04-12T14:20:01Z worker-3 INFO incoming request id=req-9f2e token_count=48
2026-04-12T14:20:01Z runtime DEBUG reuse_kv_cache shard=shard-7 key_prefix=global seq_offset=462
2026-04-12T14:20:01Z runtime WARN kv_cache.size=8192400 entries=786432
2026-04-12T14:20:02Z runtime ERROR mismatch: expected_seq=462 got_seq=1 req=req-9f2e
2026-04-12T14:20:02Z model ERROR generation aborted: corrupted kv cache entries
2026-04-12T14:20:02Z worker-3 OOM Killed
```

eva_prod-systems: that mismatch log looks like stale seq offsets getting reused across requests. we've hypothesized cross-request leakage before.

ben_runtime: yes — root cause theory: continuous batching code reuses KV cache slots but doesn't reset per-request base_seq when a previous request had longer prefix. so subsequent smaller requests read wrong values at non-zero offsets. leads to model context corruption.

frank_support: any customer impact yet? which tenants hit errors?

alice_oncall: telemetry shows ~12 customers had elevated error rates and garbled outputs (wrong completions) between 14:20 and 14:42. Some high-SLA customers flagged. Triage group forming.

carol_sre: mitigation plan options: 1) immediate: disable continuous batching on us-west-2 to stop KV reuse path; 2) flush per-shard KV caches and restart affected workers; 3) hotfix check to validate seq_offset before reuse. Suggest do 1 & 2 immediately, 3 as next step.

ben_runtime: I can push a non-disruptive config toggle to disable continuous batching at runtime for the region. command: `curl -XPOST \"https://controlplane.internal/regions/us-west-2/config\" -d '{"continuous_batching":false}'`

alice_oncall: do it now. I'll prepare cache flush + rolling restart for the 4 workers on shard-7.

devops-ci: starting the toggle now. response: 200 OK. continuous_batching disabled for us-west-2.

incident-bot: DeployBot: config-change by ben_runtime to us-west-2 (continuous_batching=false) at 1867500060. CI checks passed.

ben_runtime: confirming queue drain behavior — we'll let in-flight batches finish, but no new grouping. expecting latency to improve quickly, cost to go up.

alice_oncall: kicking off cache flush script: 
```
for pod in $(kubectl get pods -l shard=shard-7 -o name); do
  kubectl exec $pod -- /bin/sh -c "runtimectl flush-kv --shard=shard-7" || echo flush-failed-$pod
  kubectl rollout restart pod/$pod
done
```

devops-ci: flush completed on pod worker-3, worker-4; restart triggered. worker-5 restart failed once due to image pull delay, retried and succeeded.

carol_sre: monitoring memory and 5xxs. early signs: mem back to baseline, 5xx rate decreasing.

frank_support: notifying affected customers via status page with a note that some completions were corrupted; we are rolling mitigations. drafting message.

grace_pm: log a quick customer-impact summary: window ~14:20-14:42 UTC, cause suspected kv reuse leading to cross-request context leakage. ETA for full resolution?

alice_oncall: after cache flush + disable batching, errors dropped to baseline at 14:36. plan to keep continuous batching off until we patch. ETA for patch: ~3–4 hours to get a safe seq_offset guard and add more unit+integration tests.

ben_runtime: working on minimal hotfix: validate seq_offset origin before reusing cache entries. pseudo-patch: 
```
// before reuse
if (cache_entry.base_req_id != current_req_id && cache_entry.seq_offset != expected_base) {
  // skip reuse, rebuild from model
  log.warn("kv reuse rejected: stale base", cache_entry.base_req_id, current_req_id);
  continue;
}
```

ben_runtime: also adding a namespace salt per-tenant to the cache key to avoid cross-tenant collision. running unit tests now.

carol_sre: good. also add a runtime flag to fail-open (i.e., skip reuse) if offsets diverge > 16 tokens to avoid subtle corruption.

alice_oncall: rolling handoff: i'm on for another 30m then ben takes oncall for patch rollout. documenting actions in the incident doc.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident escalated to ENG-Runtime and SRE oncall at 1867500105.

frank_support: status page update posted: "We are investigating increased errors and corrupted outputs for some requests in us-west-2. Mitigation underway: continuous batching disabled, affected workers restarted. No data leak beyond context corruption suspected. More updates in 30 minutes."

grace_pm: any telemetry on model hallucination vs corrupted tokens? we need to be precise in customer comms.

alice_oncall: initial sample diffs show injected tokens from previous sessions rather than typical hallucination patterns. so avoid the word "hallucination" in comms. say "context corruption due to KV cache reuse bug".

ben_runtime: patch branch created: `fix/kv-guard-seq` will run through canary fleet in 2h, then gradual rollout. adding 2 new integration tests: cross-request seq divergence and tenant isolation stress test.

carol_sre: postmortem actions to capture: 1) add metrics for seq_offset mismatch rate; 2) e2e test that simulates mixed-length prefixes concurrently; 3) safety default to disable reuse unless validated; 4) runbook update for cache flush steps.

alice_oncall: can we get a short mitigation timeline for customers?

ben_runtime: immediate mitigation done (disable + flush). Hotfix ETA ~3h, canary+monitor 2h after that, full rollout by EOD if tests pass.

frank_support: I'll update customers with ETA and that we've implemented a mitigation that stopped incorrect outputs.

alice_oncall: handing off to ben_runtime for the remainder. my last check: errors at baseline, memory stable, no further OOMs. I'm documenting and creating the incident ticket.

ben_runtime: I'll own patch and rollout. starting with canary in eu-central to validate tests, then us-west-2. will post progress here.

incident-bot: Note: please file an incident postmortem at https://intern.alex/redwood/incidents/1867500000 when resolved.

carol_sre: thumbs up. also add a priority compliance check: ensure no sensitive user prompt bits were spilled into other sessions — we need to verify tenant isolation.

ben_runtime: running tenant-scoped sanity checks against logs; preliminary check shows no cross-tenant plaintext leakage, only context corruption within tenant sessions. will run deeper scan.

frank_support: copied CS to thread for customer followups: @frank_support @grace_pm.

alice_oncall: leaving now, handing oncall to ben_runtime. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

ben_runtime: taking over. will update in 30m or on any regression.

carol_sre: closing the incident channel for noise; move follow-ups to #postmortems once patch is in.

incident-bot: Incident 1867500000 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
